textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 maths · Large Numbers Around Us · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Let us begin with a pattern. The largest 3-digit number is 999, and when we add 1 we reach 1,000, the smallest 4-digit number.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Let us begin with a pattern. The largest 3-digit number is 999, and when we add 1 we reach 1,000, the smallest 4-digit number. The largest 4-digit number is 9,999, and one more gives 10,000, the smallest 5-digit number.
beats.speakEn: Let us begin with a pattern. The largest 3-digit number is 999, and when we add 1 we reach 1,000, the smallest 4-digit number. The largest 4-digit number is 9,999, and one more gives 10,000, the smallest 5-digit number.

beats.en: In the Indian system we place commas to read big numbers easily. The first comma comes after the hundreds place, then after every two digits. Take 12,78,830.
beats.speakEn: In the Indian system we place commas to read big numbers easily. The first comma comes after the hundreds place, then after every two digits. Take 12,78,830.
